messages:
Lena: Quick heads-up 
Onboarding call with KeyWeave tomorrow 9am PT. Scope: SSO/SAML nameID, SCIM group semantics, BYOK into our KMS, and marketplace tile content. Need owners.

Omar: I'll own SSO + SCIM mappings. Request from partner: do they support SCIM incremental (PATCH) and group filters? Also need their SAML metadata (entityID, ACS, cert).

Pri: Security will own BYOK/KMS + HSM attestations. Requirements: partner must provide PKCS#8 public key, cert chain, and HSM vendor + attestation report. Preferred wrap algos: RSA-OAEP-256. We'll run a key-import and rotation test in staging.

Grace: Legal: embargo window please. We'll need logo permissions and quote sign-off. If they request SOC2 language, we'll add an NDA addendum (2 business days to draft once NDA signed).

announce-bot: Reminder: fill out onboarding checklist at https://internal/onboard/keyweave and attach artifacts.

Omar: Sample SCIM test curl for partner:
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"jlee","name":{"givenName":"Jun","familyName":"Lee"},"emails":[{"value":"jlee@keyweave.com"}]}'

Pri: Rotation note: partner keys must allow rewrap so tokens don't break. Security sign-off ETA: ~3 business days after artifacts received. Send HSM attestation to pri@redwood.ai.

Lena: Proposed timeline: canary on Dedicated in 8 days, marketplace tile live ~3 weeks after canary. Grace please confirm embargo constraints; Omar/Pri post blockers by EOD. I'll aggregate artifacts in /projects/partners/keyweave and send calendar invite. Thanks! :thumbsup:
